name: Crab Walk
steps: Sit on the floor with knees bent, feet flat hip-width apart, and hands planted behind your hips with fingers turned slightly back or out.
Press through your palms and heels to lift your hips cleanly off the floor into a tabletop bridge.
Move smoothly forward or backward by stepping your opposite hand and foot together in alternating strides.
Continue crawling steadily with lifted hips and braced core for the target duration before sitting down gently.
tips: Keep your chest open and hips elevated rather than letting your glutes drag toward the floor.
Turn your fingers slightly outward if pointing straight back causes wrist discomfort.
